Sanctions for employees and contracted clinicians
No BAA no ePHI; annual review of key vendors
Security requirements and inventory for devices and OT

Unique accounts; view-only kiosks; no shared logins
MFA for remote, email, cloud, vendor access; hardware keys for admins
Same-day removal; end dates on contracted and agency accounts

statement_summary: Quarterly access reviews; monthly agency reconciliation
Break-glass accounts; logged EHR emergency access
Password rules; unique local admin; change device defaults
Named vendor and MSP accounts with MFA and approved windows
Incident response plan as an annex to the emergency plan
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour on the 24x7 line
Meet notification deadlines
Downtime activation and joint diversion decision; EMTALA screening continues
Annual tabletop filed as the emergency program's additional exercise
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit
Sanitize devices before repair; certified destruction
Isolated immutable backups tested quarterly
Custody and back-entry of downtime paper records
Training before access and annually; reminders; phishing exercises
Approved generative AI tools only
No changes to device or clinical decision support settings outside change control
